| `F:bm.field_l:[Lnf;` | `logoMeshes` | ni loads logo.fo3d through the supplied archive and guard-derived group index, reads mesh count, starts bit access, decodes materials through jc and meshes through uh, then ends bit access. Native18 null-archive traces preserve array references and diagnostic context. Successful real archive/mesh loading is source-audited, not verified by this probe. ck renders the animated logo.fo3d meshes. It installs a Q16 camera with Z=-8144, computes rotated bounds midpoint depths, repeatedly selects the strictly greatest depth, marks that key MIN_VALUE, applies selected-mesh rotation, then adds centers by draw-order index before projection and lighting. The source can reselect a mesh if all keys are MIN_VALUE; no universal permutation/stable-sort claim is made. Default light rotates with logo tick; valid pointer snapshots override it, and light/half vectors normalize to Q8 with original overflow/NaN casts. Guard division follows rendering, so failed calls may have drawn. Native56862-case logo trace includes804 successful controlled scenes,216 pixel-changing scenes,72 zero-rotation draw-order/depth oracles and all21 shared geometry/queue buffers; whole pixel rendering lacks a new independent oracle and real archive loading remains unverified. |

| `L:ul.b(I)V#25` | `tripleSharesVariant` | Integer boolean for the gated central/first/second sprite-variant match. Increments the variant-match counter and sets packed bit 30. |
| `L:ul.b(I)V#26` | `largestPackedEntityId` | Initially the central entity ID, then permuted by the three-way descending sort. The final largest ID occupies packed bits 20..29; this variable is not permanently the central entity ID. |
| `L:ul.b(I)V#27` | `middlePackedEntityId` | Initially the first neighbor ID, then permuted by the descending sort. The final middle ID occupies packed bits 10..19. |
| `L:ul.b(I)V#28` | `smallestPackedEntityId` | Initially the second neighbor ID, then permuted by the descending sort. The final smallest ID occupies packed bits 0..9. |

| `P:ud.a(BI)V#0` | `methodGuard` | Achievement response source audit (pass109): cf.a(II)Lqi; creates and queues an incomplete qi query before guard arithmetic, then sends version1/subtype2 via re.b(II)V. qg.b(I)V initializes the singleton query used by je. ud.b(I)V consumes response type0/count/full integers into an eight-value array before checking the oldest query, stores values/completed/first mask and unlinks that query; type1 unlinks the oldest retained submission; type2 stores eight zeros/first mask/completed and unlinks the oldest query. Empty response queues call jl.a(B)V to close the session socket; unknown types log and close. ud.a(BI)V resends submissions then queries without removing them. qi.d(I)Z requires a positive received mask and bit16.
